summary: Returns the value as a sheet name, or throws.
description: What Google Sheets accepts: at most 100 characters, not blank, none of `\ / ? * [ ]`, and not the reserved name `history` in any case.
`isX` and `nonX` answer a question and never interrupt control flow; `requireX` and `requireNonX` hand the value back or throw. The scheme is explained in [](validation-conventions.md).

params.message: The message of the exception. A default is used when omitted.
params.strict: When `true`, a string counts as empty only if it has no characters at all; by default whitespace is trimmed first.

returns: the same value, typed as a sheet name.

throws.IllegalArgumentException: the value is not a sheet name.

examples.title: What passes and what does not
examples.body:
```javascript
requireValidSheetName("Data"); // => "Data"
requireValidSheetName("Report 2026"); // => "Report 2026"
requireValidSheetName("history"); // throws IllegalArgumentException
requireValidSheetName("Data/2026"); // throws IllegalArgumentException
```
